## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes, if the UI changed
- [ ] New UI text is in both `locales/es.ts` and `locales/en.ts`
- [ ] Nothing leaves the browser that didn't before (no new requests, trackers or external fonts)
- [ ] Any new tables or oracle text is CC BY / CC BY-SA (or the author's permission), credited
- [ ] Code comments, test names and commit messages are in English
